name: conductor
description: Portable orchestration mode — a commander judges, decomposes, and dispatches; tiered workers execute through file contracts (L1 doctrine / L2 contracts / L3 adapters). v3: measured gate economics (family-indexed discipline price), fan-out amortization brake, role cards as cached grading, two-tier ledger with a tier-0 collector and a human-gated calibration loop.
